verdict.rationale: Close documents custom fields with a configurable name, data type, multi-value setting and edit permissions, and shared custom fields usable across leads and custom activities. An Advanced Filtering API exists for finding contacts, but nothing shows filtered, sorted, or shared saved views, or that an ops user can do this without admin or developer effort. Missing for 10: saved/filtered views, sorting, shared views, evidence of self-serve no-admin setup, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: you define its name, the type of data that's going to be stored on it, whether it can store multiple values or not, who in your organization can edit its values
a single Shared Custom Field can be assigned to Leads, and several different Custom Activities.
To easily find contacts that match specific conditions, use the Advanced Filtering API.
